summary: Chunk 1 v8 Frontend testing (Playwright 390x844, Abhijit.patil / Admin@123). TASK 2 (Zygoma/Pterygoid Card Redesign) PASSES end-to-end on Quad Zygoma case 6a854ae0b4683aab80704d86: 4 pre-populated rows render as Conventional-style cards — orange badge (R1/R2/L1/L2), titles 'Zygoma Right' / 'Zygoma Left', green Active chip (zyg-status-{idx}), orange ZYGOMA type-pill, specs 'Refirm · Z-Series' and 'D: 4mm | L: 45/50mm', plus Edit (zyg-edit-implant-{idx}) and Remove (zyg-delete-implant-{idx}) buttons in the actions row. Tapping Edit on row 0 opens the specialized modal with 'Edit Implant' header, ZYGOMA badge, Side chips (Right/Left present via zyg-side-Right/Left), Refirm Z-Series system, diameter (Ø4) and length picker. Tapping Remove on row 3 triggered the native confirm dialog ('Remove implant?') and was dismissed successfully. Mixed-case regression on 6a86acfc08151ce737bf7390: Zygoma / Pterygoid Implant Planning header renders with config '2 zygoma + anterior conventional', divider 'Conventional Implants' visible, and standard 'Add Conventional Implant' button below — Conventional flow preserved. TASK 1 (Patient Card Zygoma/Pterygoid Pills) is BLOCKED by seed data: the pill code (procedures.tsx L244-274) is correctly implemented with all required testIDs, but every Zygoma/Pterygoid case in the DB (including the two target IDs) has status='draft' and DefaultProceduresScreen filters drafts out of the My Cases list (procedures.tsx L86). No non-draft Zygoma/Pterygoid procedure exists for any user, so the pill container can never render on the My Cases screen in the current environment. Pre-existing 'Unexpected text node' console warnings persist (already noted in iter-407, unrelated to this iteration).

integration_issues.flow: TASK 1 — Patient Card Zygoma Pills visibility on My Cases
integration_issues.issue: Target seed cases (6a854ae0b4683aab80704d86 Quad Zygoma and 6a86acfc08151ce737bf7390 Zyg+Conv) are in status='draft'. DefaultProceduresScreen filters out drafts (procedures.tsx L86: 'response.data.filter(p => p.status !== draft)'). No non-draft Zygoma/Pterygoid case exists in DB, so the pill container zyg-pills-{id} never renders on the My Cases list and the visual test cannot be executed against real data. The pill code itself is correct on inspection.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing console error spam: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' appears repeatedly on both zygoma detail page and My Cases page. Documented in iter-407 as not introduced by this iteration but still present.

action_items: TASK 2 (Card Redesign): mark working=true, needs_retesting=false — verified end-to-end.

TASK 1 (Patient Card Pills): DO NOT mark working=true yet. Either (a) transition an existing Zygoma case out of draft (e.g. submit-phase1 on 6a854ae0b4683aab80704d86 as its student Gaurav.pandey → then approve to leave draft), or (b) create a fresh Quad Zygoma + Zyg+Conv case via the New Case flow so status=pending_phase1 and it surfaces on My Cases. After that, re-run Task 1 verification to visually confirm the orange Zygoma pill, purple config pill ('Quad zygoma' / '2 zygoma + anterior conventional'), and non-zygoma regression card absence.
Consider (optional): audit the 'Unexpected text node' console warning — appears to come from stray whitespace or empty template literal between JSX children; not blocking but noisy.
critical_code_review_comments: procedures.tsx L244-274: pill IIFE correctly guards on regex /zygoma/i and /pterygoid/i and only renders the container when at least one of hasZyg/hasPter is true. numberOfLines={1} on the config pill is fine, but very long configuration strings will be truncated with no ellipsis fallback (maxWidth 240 on zygPill). Consider showing a tooltip or wrapping to 2 lines on wide configs.

ZygomaImplantSelection.tsx L138: fallback branch for row.implant_type === 'conventional' uses colors {bg:#FFFDE7...} but per the new v7 architecture, conventional rows in mixed cases are rendered by the parent CaseImplantPlanning, not by ZygomaImplantSelection. This fallback path is likely dead. Safe to leave as-is but could be pruned for clarity.
ZygomaImplantSelection.tsx L152: for row.implant_type === 'conventional' the title falls back to `FDI ${row.tooth_position}` — same dead-path note as above.

ZygomaImplantSelection.tsx cardSt.actions has paddingLeft: 48 to align under the badge column — good. Touch targets for Edit/Remove text buttons are only ~40x18 which is smaller than the 44pt guideline; consider expanding hitSlop or padding. Not blocking.
